research_problem: Fragmented research on automated testing of RESTful APIs; need for a comprehensive map of approaches, tools and challenges
technical_approach: Systematic literature review: 7 databases (search 1 Mar 2022) + forward/backward snowballing (14 Jun 2022); 92 articles; 12 RQs; dual-author extraction
primary_contribution: Taxonomies of metrics, techniques, testing types, artifacts, open-source tools (16), non-research tools (20), addressed (Table 10) and open (Table 11) challenges
baselines: Not applicable (survey); compared in scope to an earlier 16-article survey
key_findings: Sharp growth since 2017 (peak 24 papers in 2021); 73% of approaches black-box; all white-box work built on EvoMaster; fault detection mostly via 5xx/schema violation; performance metrics rare; 14% of papers lack case studies; top open challenges: tool support (25), more case studies (13), security testing (10), automated oracles (4), classifying test results (4)
author_limitations: Possible missed articles; manual selection/extraction errors; authors wrote 16 of 92 papers; tool feature info may be incomplete
analyst_limitations: Literature cut-off mid-2022 (no LLM-era work); no quality appraisal of included studies; possible white-box/EvoMaster-centric perspective; minor count inconsistency (61 vs 62 approach papers); read version is arXiv v1
reproducibility: Search strings, dates and inclusion criteria published; extraction sheet availability not stated
suggested_extensions: LLM-era update survey re-assessing Table 11 challenges; focus on performance testing and test-result classification
evidence_location: RQs p.5 L333-351; method p.6-7; RQ5 p.17-20; RQ7 p.22-23; Table 10 p.27; Table 11 p.28; threats p.29-30
integrity: arXiv v1 read; figures 2/3/6 values scattered; tables column-split but readable; diagrams absent
